stories.title: Drake Maye is reportedly out for an extended stretch, and Br0phy's best quarterback has been on his bench all year
stories.dek: NFL Network reports a significant lower leg injury that could end Maye's season. Wild Goose Chase has Jordan Love, who has outscored Maye and started exactly once.
body: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported Monday morning that Drake Maye is believed to have a significant lower leg injury that will keep him out an extended period, possibly the rest of the season. The Patriots have not confirmed anything yet; Mike Vrabel said Sunday they would know more after tests back in New England, and New England is on bye in Week 11 anyway. Maye starts for Wild Goose Chase and left Sunday's game in the first quarter after 3.02 points.

Here's the part that matters for this league: Br0phy is fine at quarterback. Probably better than fine. Jordan Love has 202.82 points this season, fifth among all quarterbacks, and Maye has 193.20. Love has started for Wild Goose Chase exactly once, in Week 2. The other nine weeks he scored 185.02 points on the bench, including 36.18 in Week 9 while Maye started and scored 18.26. Count it up and Wild Goose Chase has started 197.16 quarterback points this year when the best quarterback on the roster each week would have given it 253.34. That's 56.18 points left at one position, by the team with the most points in the league.

Bryce Young (160.68 this season) is the third quarterback on the roster, so Br0phy now has the rare luxury of two healthy starters and a reason to finally pick the right one. Week 11 is Wild Goose Chase against Nothing to see here, which is 2-7 and has given up the most points in the league.

And the projections still love this team. The Climax Bracket, built from 20,000 simulated seasons and each team's scoring average, has Wild Goose Chase at 5-5 after Monday night's expected result, 7.8 projected wins, a 77% chance to make the playoffs as the six seed, and winning the Aniston from there because it has the best scoring average in the league (131.75). The model does not know about Maye. It doesn't need to: the guy who replaces him has more points.

stories.title: Stroud of Turin drops 194.14, the best score in the league this year, and two contenders lose with the winning lineup on their own bench
stories.dek: RedDevil904 sets a perfect lineup, MakeItRains sets another one and beats Lead Nagger by 5.94, and dstafford4254 leaves 33.30 on the bench in a 26.52-point loss.
body: Stroud of Turin scored 194.14, and nobody else was close. That beats the 191.06 Wild Goose Chase put up in Week 5 for the highest score in the league this season, and it would slide in as the fifth-best week in league history once Week 10 goes final, ahead of ztw129's 193.92 from 2021. RedDevil904 got six starters over 20: Chuba Hubbard 34.2, Ja'Marr Chase 34.1, Parker Washington 28.6, Amon-Ra St. Brown 26.8, the Minnesota defense 21.0 and C.J. Stroud 20.44. The lineup was perfect. Not one bench point would have helped. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered sits at 103.66 and is down 90.48 with Zay Flowers left, so rtmcruise needs a ninety-point Monday from one receiver.

Achane in the Membrane beat Lead Nagger 170.24 to 164.30, and MakeItRains also set a perfect lineup. Jahmyr Gibbs scored 44.2 and Patrick Mahomes 36.42, and that's three straight wins for a 3-6 team that has been better than its record all year. Pudge247 got 43.5 from George Pickens, 35.1 from Emmett Johnson and 33.16 from Joe Burrow and lost anyway, because Chimere Dike scored 10.34 on the bench while Germie Bernard started for 1.0. That swap alone is 9.34 points. Lead Nagger lost by 5.94. Pudge247 added Dike on Saturday. For what, exactly?

The No. 1 team lost to a 15.5-point underdog. Bijan is your daddy beat NjigbaR Please! 128.50 to 101.98, and dstafford4254's best possible lineup was 135.28. Jordyn Tyson (19.0), Alvin Kamara (16.4) and Kaelon Black (14.6) all sat while Kyren Williams (5.2), Tetairoa McMillan (6.5) and Travis Kelce (5.0) played. FatMikeR left even more on the bench, 39.88 points including Cam Skattebo's 27.2 and Ryan Flournoy's 19.1, and won by 26.52 anyway. The four-game losing streak is over. The lesson is not.

Lawrence of a Labia beat Nothing to see here 153.88 to 104.62 behind Christian McCaffrey's 48.3, and Bill_Buttlicker gets to be 7-3 in his own newsletter. Ivefallenandicantgetup leads Wild Goose Chase 99.44 to 89.82 with Quentin Johnston and the Baltimore defense to play, and Llamageddon leads MY DAD IS DEAD 105.26 to 81.82 with Tre' Harris still to go. Monday night decides both, and it decides the Week 10 receiver payout too: George Pickens has 43.5 and three Chargers and Ravens receivers are left to chase it.

stories.title: Chargers at Ravens: Tre' Harris needs 23.45, and krunkdd bets against Derrick Henry
stories.dek: OneSillyBannana fixed the lineup at 10:35 PM, rtmcruise needs a miracle from Zay Flowers, and Derrick Henry plays from the Ivefallenandicantgetup bench.
body: OneSillyBannana made the move. At 10:35 PM ET on Sunday, MY DAD IS DEAD added Tre' Harris, dropped Justice Hill, and moved the ruled-out Ladd McConkey to the bench. Harris starts Monday night. Now the math: MY DAD IS DEAD trails Llamageddon 105.26 to 81.82 and needs 23.45 from Harris. With the best possible lineup on Sunday, MY DAD IS DEAD would have scored 107.76, which is more than Llamageddon has right now. Josh Downs (15.7) sat on the bench while Reggie Virgil started for 0.0. The Downs-for-Virgil swap was the difference.

Ivefallenandicantgetup leads Wild Goose Chase 99.44 to 89.82 with Quentin Johnston and the Baltimore defense left, so Br0phy has nobody left to play and needs a defensive disaster. The fun part: krunkdd has Derrick Henry on the bench. Henry carries no injury designation and is expected to carry the Baltimore offense with Jacoby Brissett making his first start. krunkdd started Javonte Williams (7.7) at running back instead. If Henry goes off tonight, it costs krunkdd nothing in the standings and a lot in this newsletter.

Breece'sBurdenDeflowered trails Stroud of Turin by 90.48 with Zay Flowers to play. rtmcruise also has Brissett on the bench behind Matthew Stafford (19.76). That game is over. Llamageddon has Ja'Kobi Lane (BAL) on the bench and Lead Nagger has Omarion Hampton (LAC) on the bench, and neither one matters now.

The Week 10 payout is Highest-Scoring Receiver, and George Pickens leads with 43.5 for Pudge247. Ja'Marr Chase (34.1, RedDevil904) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (32.1, dstafford4254) are next. The starting receivers left are Zay Flowers (rtmcruise), Quentin Johnston (krunkdd) and Tre' Harris (OneSillyBannana). Any of them needs 43.6 to take the money. Pudge247 lost the game and is about to win the payout, which is the most Lead Nagger thing possible.

stories.title: The Week 10 wire: one claim, a late-night Tre' Harris add, and Sunday morning belongs to ChuckJ10
stories.dek: Every waiver claim and free-agent add from Weeks 9 and 10, kept apart from the trade talk.
body: Week 10 waivers (one claim): MakeItRains claimed Marvin Harrison Jr. for $1 and dropped Keon Coleman. Harrison was ruled out with a hamstring injury and sat on the Achane in the Membrane bench. Week 9 waivers: krunkdd paid $22 for Jakobi Meyers (dropped Chris Bell), Pudge247 paid $20 for Tank Dell (dropped Darius Cooper), ChuckJ10 paid $3 for Darren Waller (dropped Greg Dulcich) and $0 for J.J. McCarthy, krunkdd paid $2 for the Baltimore defense (dropped Philadelphia), dcrabb paid $2 for the Green Bay defense, OneSillyBannana took Justice Hill (dropped Joe Milton) and Reggie Virgil (dropped Marvin Harrison Jr.) for $0, and RedDevil904 took Pat Freiermuth (dropped Jake Ferguson) for $0.

Week 10 free-agent adds: Bill_Buttlicker added Konata Mumpfield (dropped Gardner Minshew II), Fernando Mendoza and Tutu Atwell (dropped Drew Lock). OneSillyBannana added the Kansas City defense (dropped Chicago), added and then dropped TreVeyon Henderson, added Tyler Higbee, and on Sunday at 10:35 PM ET added Tre' Harris and dropped Justice Hill. Pudge247 added Pat Bryant and Chimere Dike, rtmcruise added Jacoby Brissett, krunkdd added Elic Ayomanor, and on Sunday morning ChuckJ10 swapped New Orleans for the Indianapolis defense and dcrabb added Zonovan Knight.

How it paid off: ChuckJ10's Indianapolis defense scored 13.0, the best move Nothing to see here made all week. Tyler Higbee scored 10.7 in the MY DAD IS DEAD lineup. Tutu Atwell scored 4.1 in the Lawrence of a Labia flex while Konata Mumpfield scored 11.1 on the bench. Chimere Dike scored 10.34 on the Lead Nagger bench in a 5.94-point loss, which makes him the most expensive free player of the week. Elic Ayomanor scored 12.9 on the Ivefallenandicantgetup bench. Tre' Harris plays tonight.

FAAB spent so far, out of $200: Bijan is your daddy has spent $0, Llamageddon $5, Lawrence of a Labia $9, Wild Goose Chase $50, Ivefallenandicantgetup $58, Achane in the Membrane $117, Nothing to see here $142, Lead Nagger $150 and Stroud of Turin $190. NjigbaR Please!, Breece'sBurdenDeflowered and MY DAD IS DEAD are tapped out at $200. FatMikeR still has the whole bag and still has Cam Skattebo on the bench.

columns.title: A 5-5 TEAM WINNING THE ANISTON?! Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner has SEEN the Climax Bracket and he is NOT OKAY
columns.dek: The model says Wild Goose Chase sneaks in as the six seed and wins it all. Barry has questions. Loud ones.
body: I've been in this press box since before most of you knew what a flex spot was, and I have NEVER seen anything like what I saw this morning. The Climax Bracket ran 20,000 seasons. TWENTY THOUSAND. And the team it crowns is Wild Goose Chase. Five and four right now, five and five after tonight unless the Baltimore defense forgets how to stand up. SIX SEED. And it wins the whole thing.

Now, do I HATE it? Let me tell you what I hate. I hate that it's RIGHT. Wild Goose Chase has 1,185.74 points, the most in the league. It averages 131.75 a week, the best in the league. It's 62-37 in all-play, second-best in the league. The team is GOOD. The team is just managed by a man who has started Jordan Love ONE TIME this year while Love scored 185.02 points on the bench!

ONE TIME! And now NFL Network says Drake Maye could miss an extended stretch, and suddenly the best quarterback on the roster gets the job by FORCE. You know what that is? That's the fantasy football gods doing Br0phy's lineup for him. And they're better at it.

Word around the press box is that Br0phy has already set Bryce Young as his Week 11 starter out of pure spite, then changed it back, then changed it again, and Sleeper has started sending him a notification that just says 'are you sure.' None of this is confirmed. I made it up while yelling at a vending machine.

Meanwhile the model has Ivefallenandicantgetup as the ONE seed at a projected 10.5 wins with 100% playoff odds, and it still only gives krunkdd a 21% shot at the title. Lead Nagger 20%. NjigbaR Please! 20%. Wild Goose Chase 16%. Nobody is a lock. NOBODY! Four weeks left, and the six seed is the favorite to win the final. WAKE UP, PEOPLE! THIS LEAGUE IS CHAOS AND I LOVE IT AND I HATE IT AND I NEED A NAP!

columns.title: Br0phy had three quarterbacks and picked the right one four times out of ten. That's soft.
columns.dek: Dick Fitzwell goes to the tape on 56.18 quarterback points Wild Goose Chase left on the bench.
body: In the film room we had a rule: the depth chart is earned on tape, not on vibes. Wild Goose Chase has carried three quarterbacks all year, Drake Maye, Jordan Love and Bryce Young, and the tape says Br0phy started the best one in only four of ten weeks.

Here's the tape. Starting quarterbacks for Wild Goose Chase: 197.16 points in ten weeks. The best quarterback on that roster each week: 253.34. That's 56.18 points. Week 9 alone, Maye started and scored 18.26 while Love scored 36.18 on the bench. Week 1, Maye 9.82, Love 20.48 on the bench. Week 3, Young started for 13.64, Love scored 18.48 on the bench.

I'll be fair, because the film doesn't lie in either direction. Some of those weeks Maye was the right call. He went for 39.46 in Week 5 and 28.44 in Week 7. And this isn't about Maye getting hurt Sunday; nobody plans for that. It's about having a guy with 202.82 points, fifth among all quarterbacks, holding a clipboard for nine weeks.

I'm told Br0phy keeps all three quarterbacks because he read somewhere that real teams carry three and figured that applied to fantasy too. Sources say he also sits Love because 'the Packers wear green and green means go, and he wanted Love to stay ready.' Not confirmed. Doesn't need to be.

Lesson: Love starts Week 11 against Nothing to see here, which has allowed the most points in the league. No more excuses, no more vibes. Wild Goose Chase has the most points in the league and a 5-4 record. That gap is coaching. Fix it.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Monday night survival guide for the four teams still sweating
columns.dek: Oliver Klozoff has moved the lawn chair closer to the TV for Chargers at Ravens and has advice. None of it should be followed.
body: 1. OneSillyBannana: you need 23.45 from Tre' Harris. Round it down. 23 is a very normal number. Harris has scored numbers before. Numbers are basically all he scores. You're fine.

2. krunkdd: you benched Derrick Henry for Javonte Williams, who scored 7.7. Smart. A benched running back is a hungry running back, and a hungry running back runs harder next week. I bench my own legs every Monday so they're fresh for Tuesday. I haven't stood up since October.
3. rtmcruise: you're down 90.48 and Zay Flowers is all you've got. Here's the plan. Text him. You don't have his number? Text a different Zay. The vibes will find their way.

4. Br0phy: you have no players left and trail by 9.62. My advice is to root for the Baltimore defense to give up 50. Then root for the Chargers to not do that, because Quentin Johnston is a Charger. Then root for both. This is called hedging and I learned it from a lawn chair.

5. Word around the lawn is that krunkdd benched Derrick Henry 'to keep him humble.' I'm told Henry hasn't been informed. Neither has krunkdd. None of this is confirmed, but I'd do the same, and I'm sitting in a lawn chair.

6. Pudge247: you already lost, but George Pickens has 43.5 and leads the receiver payout. Do not watch the game. If you watch, Zay Flowers gets 44. Go to bed at 8:14 PM. I go to bed at 6. That's why I'm so rested and so wrong.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: perfect lineups and terrible lineups both went undefeated this week, so lineups don't matter
columns.dek: Connie has run Week 10 through the model and found the one variable that predicts winning. It is not the one you think. It is barely a variable.
body: Two teams set a perfect lineup in Week 10: Stroud of Turin (194.14, zero points left on the bench) and Achane in the Membrane (170.24, also zero). Both won. That is a 2-0 record, a 100% win rate, and a sample size I am comfortable building a career on.

But then look at Bijan is your daddy. FatMikeR's best possible score was 168.38. He scored 128.50. He left 39.88 points on the bench, the most of any team this week, including Cam Skattebo's 27.2. He won by 26.52. So the team with the worst lineup management in the league is also undefeated this week. 1-0. Also 100%.

Now look at the middle. NjigbaR Please! left 33.30 and lost. Lead Nagger left 12.34 and lost by 5.94. Lawrence of a Labia left 11.9 and won. The data clearly says the dangerous zone is between 0.01 and 39.87 points left on the bench. Either set a perfect lineup or set the worst one you can. Moderation is for losers. The numbers don't lie, and if they do, they lie in my favor.

One more data point. Sources close to my spreadsheet say Pudge247 has filed a formal grievance against Germie Bernard's 1.0, with Chimere Dike signing as a witness. None of this is confirmed, but the regression line is pointing straight at it.

Final takeaway: in Week 10, the team that scored more points won every single game that's finished. I have checked this six times. It holds. I'm calling it the Lingus Coefficient and I'll be accepting speaking fees.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: Wild Goose Chase vs. Ivefallenandicantgetup: the most points on the board, and it comes down to Monday night
items.dek: The highest total of Week 10 at 254.7, the most points in the league against a 7-2 team on a four-game win streak.
body: This was the game of the week on paper. Wild Goose Chase has the most points in the league, 1,185.74, scores 131.75 a week and has the second-best all-play record at 62-37. Ivefallenandicantgetup is 7-2, scores 122.98 a week and came in on a four-game win streak. Put them together and you get a 254.7 total, the highest on the board.

The line was Wild Goose Chase by 11.5. That's the 8.77-point gap in scoring average plus 3 points because Ivefallenandicantgetup had Chris Godwin Jr. and Courtland Sutton on byes and two empty lineup spots when the line went up. krunkdd filled both.

Then Sunday happened. Drake Maye left in the first quarter in Munich after 3.02 points, and Wild Goose Chase finished at 89.82 with nobody left to play. Ivefallenandicantgetup leads 99.44 to 89.82 with Quentin Johnston and the Baltimore defense still to go on Monday night, and Derrick Henry sitting on the bench. Unless the Baltimore defense has a historically bad night, this pick is dead. NFL Network reported Monday that Maye could miss an extended stretch.

body: Every week somebody plays in the sewer game. MY DAD IS DEAD came in 1-8 with the lowest scoring average in the league, 100.59, and a 20-79 all-play record. Llamageddon came in 4-5 and without Puka Nacua, who the Rams hope gets back in about five weeks. The line was Llamageddon by 20.5, the biggest on the board, after a 3-point nudge toward MY DAD IS DEAD for Nacua and a Denver defense on bye sitting in the Llamageddon lineup.

It played like a shit show. Llamageddon finished at 105.26, its fourth-lowest score of the year. Brock Bowers scored 3.8 and Tre Tucker 1.9. MY DAD IS DEAD is at 81.82, with Josh Downs (15.7) on the bench while Reggie Virgil started for 0.0.

OneSillyBannana moved the ruled-out Ladd McConkey to the bench at 10:35 PM Sunday and added Tre' Harris. Harris plays Monday night and needs 23.45 to steal it. The pick is Llamageddon by 20.5, and it's sitting at 23.44 with one Charger left.

body: On paper this was the easiest call of the week. NjigbaR Please! came in 7-2 with the best all-play record in the league, 65-34, scoring 126.40 a week.
